figure.title: Figure 5 (continued). (b) Drag coefficient. Variation with lift coefficient of the aerodynamic characteristics for the 10.8 deg sweptback wing.
figure.x_axis: Lift coefficient, C_L, on staggered scales, same layout as figure 5(a). Common axis used here = the M = 0.50 scale: left frame line = -0.2, grid every 0.1, right frame line = 3.2 (35 vertical lines). Label row: -.2 at the left frame, one '0' per Mach number every 0.2 (M = 0.50 ... 1.114, 13 zeros), then .2, .4, .6, .8 on the M = 1.114 scale (.8 at the right frame). Each '0' is centred within 0 to 8 px of a vertical grid line (labels at x = 611, 739, 868, 997, 1127, 1257, 1382, 1513, 1647, 1776, 1907, 2035, 2161 px; grid lines 0.0 to 2.4 at 604.5 to 2157 px on row 1150). CL = 0 is at common-axis 0.0 (M 0.50), 0.4 (0.85), 1.0 (0.95), 1.4 (1.00), 2.2 (1.10).
figure.y_axis: Drag coefficient, C_D (grid 0 to 0.22 by 0.01; frame lines at 0 and 0.22). The Mach-number box sits between C_D = 0 and about 0.0045, below the 0.01 grid line.
figure.content_note: One hollow symbol shape with a centre dot per Mach number (same shapes as figure 5(a)), on one faired polar per Mach number. Same test points as figure 5(a): crowded low-drag symbols were matched to figure 5(a) by lift coefficient.
